retainedBaseline.boundary: Identical resident prepared 8-bit 4:4:4 JPEG to independent owned RGBA8. Public managed Decode, allocation and disposal; native software mjpeg decoder, per-operation state reset, full-range BT.601 conversion, owned output allocation and release. Native context/conversion/input packet/frame wrappers reused; every call decodes and converts all pixels. Padded native rows are exposed without a gratuitous packing copy. Startup, I/O, IPC, generation, hashing, checks and tight-row file writes excluded. No encoder quality search or additional source raster. Decoder RGB maximum 4/RMSE 1.5, exact opaque alpha.

provenance: Frozen prepared native qscale-5 JPEG from HorizontalFlipInput.Create(8), original deterministic asymmetric RGBA8 flattened once on RGB 0x204060. 133041 bytes, common 1x2 factors (4:4:4) and variable Huffman tables. No additional source raster, upstream corpus or quality enumeration.

currentAttribution.scope: Separate current canonical-prefix NativeDecode8 warm JPEG CPU sampling; workload loops include warmup/calibration. Not parity timing.
currentAttribution.attributionRule: Match method names before the first parenthesis; parameter type names are excluded. coefficientEntropyGroup is the union of coefficient, reader and Huffman methods, not one primitive.

profileScope: One current canonical-prefix workload profile after all three candidates were reverted. Method names exclude parameter types. Workload includes warmup/calibration; profile timing is not parity timing. Use it to choose the next primitive, not to attribute rejected-candidate costs.

uncertainty: Retained baseline is historical. Candidate ratios use the faster native bracket mean. Conservative uppers use managed 99.9% confidence upper divided by the smaller native lower bound with the same critical value; nonpositive lower bounds are unbounded. Screens justify rejecting additional complexity, not certifying regressions or uniform parity. Failed post-run quietness samples and later passing cooldowns are retained. No affected-input screen after rejection.
